title: On Parameters of Nonlinear Scalar Dynamics from Video: Invariants, Calibration, and Identifiability
abstract: arXiv:2609.38877v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physical parameter estimation from video aims to recover the parameters of a known family of governing dynamical equations from pixel observations. Existing identifiability theory for this setting has focused on linear time-invariant (LTI) second-order systems, leaving open what can be identified for nonlinear scalar dynamics. We develop an identifiability theory for nonlinear scalar second-order ODEs, organized by how their velocity dependence interacts with changes of the learned state coordinate. Under a shared non-collapsed state map and explicit same-state velocity-coverage conditions, we show that parameter identifiability depends on the ODE family: some parameters are uniquely identifiable, while in other families only invariant parameter combinations are identifiable or external physical calibration is required. translated_title: 从视频中辨识非线性标量动力学的参数：不变量、标定与可辨识性
translated_abstract: 从视频中进行物理参数估计，旨在从像素观测中恢复已知形式的主导动力学方程族中的参数。针对这一场景的现有可辨识性理论主要集中于线性时不变（LTI）二阶系统，而对于非线性标量动力学能够辨识什么这一问题仍然悬而未决。我们针对非线性标量二阶常微分方程（ODE）建立了一套可辨识性理论，并按照其速度依赖性与学习状态坐标变换之间的相互作用方式来组织该理论。在共享的非退化状态映射以及明确的同状态速度覆盖条件下，我们证明参数可辨识性取决于ODE方程族本身：某些参数可以被唯一辨识，而在其他方程族中只能辨识出不变参数组合，或者需要外部物理标定。对于速度至多呈线性的动力学规律，相容性条件强制要求仿射坐标对齐，从而给出显式的参数……
tldr: 本文为从视频辨识非线性标量二阶动力学参数建立了可辨识性理论，证明可辨识性取决于ODE方程族——某些参数可唯一辨识，而其他情形只能辨识不变参数组合或需要外部物理标定。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an identifiability theory for nonlinear scalar second-order ODEs estimated from video, showing that parameter identifiability depends on the ODE family—some parameters are uniquely identifiable, while others admit only invariant combinations or require external physical calibration.
